{{Quote
|In my youth, I envied all bugs with wings. I even fancied I might grow a pair... I have since learned better. Accept the limitations of one's body... and augment with tools as needed.
|[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]
|Hr=Hornet
}}

<b>Tools</b> are equippable items in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> that give [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] access to up to 53 additional weapons and abilities. There are three categories of Tools, each identified by a colour-coded symbol:

<b>{{CrestSlot|Red|s}}</b> are active offensive tools that act as limited-use consumables. They are refilled by sitting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]], usually at the cost of {{S|[[Shell Shards]]}}. 

<b>{{CrestSlot|Blue|s}}</b> offer passive effects related to combat and survivability. No Shell Shard cost.

<b>{{CrestSlot|Yellow|s}}</b> offer passive effects that usually speed up exploration or resource gathering. No Shell Shard cost. 

Depending on the [[Crests|Crest]] used, different numbers of each coloured Tool can be equipped. Additional Tool slots can be unlocked on each Crest by using [[Memory Locket]]s. The [[Vesticrest]] can be used to provide Tool slots that are available independent of the equipped Crest.

For a list of Tool damage values, see the relevant section of the [[Damage Values and Enemy Health (Silksong)#Tools|Damage Values page]].

== Red Tools ==
[[File:Red Tools Heading.png|center]]

<b>{{CrestSlot|Red|s}}</b> are active tools that are usually limited-use consumables. They are used by pressing the [[Controls (Silksong)|SKILL/TOOL]] input combined with UP, DOWN or no direction depending on which slot they are equipped in. Most of them have a maximum capacity that must be replenished at [[Bench (Silksong)|Benches]] or by using the [[Architect Crest|Architect Crest's]] Craft Binding mechanic, usually requiring {{S|[[Shell Shards]]}} and/or a reserve pool.

Hornet can acquire 20 <b>{{CrestSlot|Red|s}}</b>, though two –the [[Snare Setter]] and [[Needle Phial]]– are removed from Hornet's inventory after certain [[Wishes]] are completed, leaving only 18 if all Wishes are completed. The [[Curveclaw]] can be upgraded and replaced in Act 3, while the [[Silkshot]] has 3 mutually exclusive variants. [[Voltvessels]] also has 2 separate forms that function differently.

== Blue Tools ==
[[File:Blue Tools Heading.png|center]]

<b>{{CrestSlot|Blue|s}}</b> are combat-focused passive support tools. They augment Hornet's abilities in combat or survivability, with some even granting her new ways to gain or use Silk.

Hornet can acquire 21 {{CrestSlot|Blue|s}}, with two –the [[Druid's Eye]] and [[Claw Mirror]]– being able to be upgraded and replaced.

== Yellow Tools ==
[[File:Yellow Tools Heading.png|center]]

<b>{{CrestSlot|Yellow|s}}</b> are "miscellaneous" passive support tools, focusing on making exploration and resource gathering easier, or providing indirect benefits. When they do provide combat functionality, their effects are usually weaker than {{CrestSlot|Blue|s}} or have a drawback.

Hornet can acquire 12 {{CrestSlot|Yellow|s}}; though one – the [[Dead Bug's Purse]] – is replaced by the [[Shell Satchel]] in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel_Soul_Mode_(Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].
